buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The bidder shall quote with bid-specific authorization directly from the OEM; otherwise, the offer will be summarily rejected without any back reference, and no representation will be entertained. The OEM’s auth orization certificate must be on the company’s letterhead and shall contain the full name, designation, acti ve e-mail address, and mobile number of the authorized signatory, along with the company’s stamp. Witho ut these details, the OEM authorization certificate will not be considered valid, and the offer will be summa rily rejected without any back reference. The buyer may seek authentication of the authorization certificat e from the OEM, if required. 2. The bidder shall submit EMD @ 2% of the estimated value (item-wise) or proper exemption documents, i .e., MSME certificate or GeM Vendor Assessment Report for the tendered item. 3. The firm must upload a certificate mentioning the percentage of local content in the material being offer ed. Please enter 0 for fully imported items and 100 for fully indigenous items. The definition and calculatio n of local content shall be in accordance with the Make in India policy. The firm must certify that the item offered meets the minimum local content requirement and shall provide details of the locations where loca l value addition is carried out. 4. For past performance, the firm shall attach proof of supply signed by either the purchaser, consignee, or inspector nominated by the purchaser (not a firm representative). Documents such as receipt notes, CRAC, receipted challans, work completion certificates, etc., should be attached. Proof of supply must clea rly indicate the quantity supplied and the date of supply. Copies of purchase orders, GeM contracts, self-si gned tax invoices, or self-prepared performance statements will not be considered as proof of completed s upply. For past performance. 5. Warranty/Guarantee certificate and test report shall be submitted at the time of delivery. 6. CPCB-IV certification must be uploaded along with the bid; otherwise, the offer will be summarily rejecte d. 7. Scope of Supply (Bid price shall include all cost components): (i) Supply, installation, testing, commissio ning of goods, training of operators, and provision of statutory clearances, if any. (ii) Necessary modificatio n work for the installation of the DG set, if required, shall be carried out by the seller (iii) Any other materia ls required for the installation or commissioning of the DG set shall be provided by th e seller. (iv) Loading, unloading, transportation, and proper packing of the DG sets shall be the responsibility of the supplier. 8. The bidder shall accept the Additional conditions/parameters/ Instruction to Bidder, General technical re quirement, ATC document, and FORM-A (Standing Indemnity Bond for On-Account Payments) with signatur e and stamp. The bidder shall submit filled Annexure-A and Annexure-B. Merely signing, stamping, or sub mitting a catalogue without exact specifications will lead to summary rejection of the bid without anyclarifi cation,

9. Place of Supply and Installation: (i) The work of running room, coaching/ Freight Handling Terminal at Bij wasan. 10. PAYMENT TERMS: 100% payment shall be made after installation and successful commissioning of the DG set (item-wise). 11. If the firm fails to upload any required certificate/document along with the bid, the offer will be summa rily rejected. No Fresh documents will be entertained at the stage of representation . 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of FA AND CAO/C/K.GATE payable at DELHI . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C FA AND CAO/C/K.GATE,Delh. . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of FA AND CAO/C/K.GATE payable at DELHI . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 6. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of FA AND CAO/C/K.GATE, DELHI A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract.
